title: Alchemical & Sacred Flora
body: Botanical sheet for fantasy plants, magical fungi, and sacred trees covering habitat, bloom cycles, alchemy, and folklore.

sampleValues.Appearance, Scent & Glow: Hanging silver-white blossoms shaped like tiny lanterns that smell faintly of frost and crushed mint.
sampleValues.Soil, Elevation & Symbionts: Slate scree slopes above 4,000 feet, rooted near lightning-struck pines.
sampleValues.Harvest Window & Preservation: Must be snipped with bone shears before dawn; iron blades blacken the nectar within minutes.
sampleValues.Medicinal, Poison or Arcane Effects: Brewed into fever-soothing draughts or distilled into ink that reveals invisible writing under moonlight.
sampleValues.Superstitions & Gathering Taboos: Highland shepherds never pick the tallest stem, leaving it as a lantern for lost travelers' spirits.
